Four new Pit frames inspected individually against poses. Six replacement Long Doors/approach frames inspected individually; six initial frames retained privately as rejects. Four B Doors replacements inspected individually, three rejected camera attempts preserved privately. Three B/A site additions inspected individually; initial B plan rejected for clipped rear extent. Five B/A site additions inspected individually; initial B plan rejected for clipped rear extent. Four Short stair views inspected individually; reverse nearest treads clipped, complete flight supported by forward/side views. Closer stair flight image inspected individually; numeric count remains separate from perspective review. Five Catwalk views inspected individually; initial roof-dominated plan rejected for clipped route extent. Four Mid Doors views inspected individually; close-leaf reverse and lamp-obstructed elevation attempts rejected and replaced.
